key.name: model
key.description: parakeet-v2-en: English only, most accurate for English. parakeet-v3: 25 European languages, detected automatically.

key.name: live-captions
key.summary: Show a live caption while recording
key.description: Turning this off also saves the CPU spent re-reading the current phrase.

key.name: noise-filter
key.description: Drops words that are much quieter than your own voice, such as a TV or people across the room. Higher is stricter.

key.name: icon-offset
key.summary: Move the button image up (negative) or down, in percent of the button size
key.description: The image is centred automatically; this is for fine-tuning.

key.name: action-buttons
key.summary: Show Delete and Enter buttons after text is typed

key.name: action-buttons-timeout
key.summary: Seconds before the Delete and Enter buttons hide by themselves
